Thanks for the quick clarification, Alice — very helpful. Below is a concise breakdown you can share with procurement (I kept it focused on the $/1M token lens plus the practical implications we typically see). Happy to convert to a one-pager if you want a PDF.

Redwood unit economics (typical ranges) — $/1M tokens (pilot volumes, hosted):
- Redwood Hosted (mixed open models + optimizations): $650 – $900 / 1M tokens (lower end with batching, prefix caching, and pilot-level batching)
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity, commit): $350 – $600 / 1M tokens (depends on commit and model quantization)

Benchmarks vs public providers (list price equivalents, non-exhaustive):
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-ish / large instruct): ~ $1,200 – $2,000 / 1M tokens (depending on model and context window; lower for embedding-only usage)
- Anthropic (Claude family): ~ $900 – $1,800 / 1M tokens (varies by model and throughput)
- Open-model hosts (self-hosted or managed hosts running Llama/Opt): wide range $300 – $1,200 / 1M tokens — depends on instance class, autoscaling inefficiencies, and engineering overhead.

Key notes & tradeoffs (short):
- List price vs delivered cost: public list prices (OpenAI/Anthropic) don't always map 1:1 to delivered cost at scale. Throughput, batching, and prefix caching materially change $/1M when you run real traffic.
- Latency vs cost: cheaper quantized models and aggressive batching can reduce unit cost but increase tail latency. For interactive UX (<300ms) you may pay a premium.
- Predictability: dedicated/reserved pools provide the closest route to your $700–$1,000 target at production scale; hosted plans may be fine for pilots but commits unlock lower unit economics.
- Adders: typical adders are few — occasional storage for logs or KV cache is usually minimal; we surface any support or enterprise add-ons separately. No hidden per-request connection fees in our hosted offering.

Suggested pilot packaging for Acme (100M–200M/month):
- Hosted pilot (no commit): ~$750 / 1M (estimate) — easy setup, charts/console, 99.9% SLA for hosted customers.
- 6–12 month reserved pilot (commit to 200M/month equivalent): ~ $450 / 1M (volume + commit discount + quantization options).

I attached the quick CSV + PDF with the numbers I referenced. If procurement wants, we can produce a draft SOW with committed volume and an explicit fallback plan if production scales faster.

Would you like me to set up a 20-min call with procurement and our Solutions Engineer to go over reserved vs hosted model decisions?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
